shell._note: sprite wins when assets/houses/ranch_a.png is present; the generator params below are the placeholder fallback

violations.why: Unbordered weed mass in the front turf, visible from the street. No containment, no edging, bleeds into surrounding Bermuda.
Volunteer growth in the front walk joints. Article VII 3(a) names pavement cracks explicitly.

decoys.why: Container stored at the garage face, screened from the right-of-way. R-104 is not active until Day 2 and would not be violated even then.

notes_for_designer: The teaching lot. Both findings are the same article, one in turf and one in pavement, so the player learns R-101 covers both substrates. The bin is present and deliberately unflagged-correct: it establishes the object on Day 1 so that when it becomes a violation on Day 3 the player recognises the sprite rather than meeting it cold.
